name: Bellevue, Washington
_hours: Office hours are City Hall's Service First desk (weekdays 8 AM-4 PM); most department lines are 8-5. Holidays: City Hall closures from the city calendar.

urgentLine.covers: flooding, water main breaks, sewer overflows, spills and street emergencies, 24 hours a day

_inPerson: Walk-in offices and their hours (bellevuewa.gov contact page, 2026-10-17). days: 0=Sunday … 6=Saturday. closedOnHolidays: City Hall holidays above.

openRequests._about: The city's own 311 system, read-only: lets CityDesk say a problem is already reported to the city. Public data; may not be used commercially.
openRequests.name: MyBellevue

_departments: Bellevue's real departments and what they handle, from MyBellevue 311 data (34,576 requests, Jun 2021 - Oct 2026). Phones and hours from bellevuewa.gov, 2026-10-17.

departments.name: Transportation
departments.covers: potholes and street repairs, traffic signals, streetlights, sidewalks, road debris, overgrown vegetation along roads, street signs, traffic concerns, and scooters or bikes parked in the way

departments.name: Utilities
departments.covers: water leaks, water quality, drainage and flooding, sewer problems, spills and pollution, garbage and recycling, and utility bills

departments.name: Police Department
departments.covers: non-emergency police matters: parking enforcement, abandoned vehicles, traffic enforcement requests and contacting your police sector captain

departments.name: Development Services
departments.covers: code violations such as property upkeep, construction without permits, zoning and construction noise, graffiti, and landmark tree removal
departments.hours: Code Compliance, weekdays 8 AM to 4 PM

departments.name: Community Development
departments.covers: abandoned shopping carts and help resolving conflicts with neighbors
departments.hours: weekdays 8 AM to 5 PM; Conflict Resolution Center 425-452-4091

departments.name: Parks & Community Services
departments.covers: parks, trails, park trees, playground equipment, trash in parks, pet waste and dogs off leash

departments.name: City Manager's Office
departments.covers: homelessness assistance and outreach, including encampments

departments.name: Fire Department
departments.covers: non-emergency fire matters: fireworks reports, dry vegetation fire hazards, fire station tours and community event requests

departments.name: City Hall Customer Service
departments.covers: general questions and anything that doesn't fit another department
departments.hours: Service First desk, weekdays 8 AM to 4 PM; interpretation in over 240 languages
